caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrating the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three different configurations: hidden state mean before gate, after gate, and a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 23 with linear scaling and numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, also with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 1. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," an orange dotted line for "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and a green solid line for "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The blue dashed line remains near zero from layer 0 to approximately layer 15, then increases sharply, reaching a value of approximately 2.8 at layer 23. The orange dotted line and green solid line remain close to zero across all layers, with both lines showing minimal variation; the green solid line is slightly above the orange dotted line in the later layers. The legend is positioned in the upper left corner and includes the average values for each line. The plot demonstrates a sharp rise in the pre-gating hidden state mean in deeper layers, while the post-gating and baseline means remain stable and near zero.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This line chart displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three different configurations: hidden state mean before gate, after gate, and a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", ranges from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", ranges from 0 to 4 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 1 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before gate (avg 0.71), which remains near zero from layer 0 to layer 15 (values around 0.2–0.3), then increases sharply, reaching approximately 0.9 at layer 20 and rising further to about 2.8 at layer 23. The orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after gate (avg 0.05), which stays close to zero across all layers, with values around 0.02–0.05 from layer 0 to layer 23. The green solid line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline (avg 0.04), which also remains near zero throughout, with values slightly above the post-gating mean in the final layers, reaching approximately 0.08 at layer 23. All three lines are plotted on the same axes, with the blue dashed line showing a dramatic increase in later layers compared to the relatively flat orange dotted and green solid lines.

raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: The chart is a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean," displaying the absolute mean of hidden states across model layers for three different configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 23 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 1. Three data series are plotted: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," an orange dotted line for "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and a green solid line for "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The blue dashed line remains near zero from layer 0 to layer 15, with values fluctuating slightly between 0.1 and 0.3, then rises sharply starting at layer 16, reaching approximately 0.9 at layer 18, 2.6 at layer 21, and peaking at roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The orange dotted line remains close to zero across all layers, with values consistently below 0.1, and ends near 0.05 at layer 23. The green solid line also stays near zero throughout, with values slightly above the orange line, ending at approximately 0.06 at layer 23. The blue dashed line exhibits a dramatic increase in later layers, while the orange and green lines remain nearly flat and close to zero.
